Mc2 is 0.42 µm wide. The matching current-starved devices Mc0, Mc1 and Mb1 are all 2.267 µm. A narrower starving device in stage 2 limits that stage's current most at low vctrl. At vctrl = 0.7 V the oscillation then fails or degrades (f_lo = n/a), so the tuning-ratio spec fails.
